integrity: Analytic proof is explicit and the independent finite checker derives deletion outputs directly; no independent external validation has occurred.
limitations: Uniform binary Dyck source only; number of distinct Dyck descendants after deleting one up and one down. Asymptotic mean, variance and central limit rather than an exact finite-length distribution or a code optimum. Uses an established pointwise lower-cover formula; numerical finite checks are not an independent external audit.
title: A rare-event variance anomaly for balanced-deletion outputs of random Dyck words
